# Q2TEST sends a personal message to Q1TEST, and a bulletin.
@session Q2TEST
< de Q1BBS>
> SP Q1TEST
< Title:
> Private
< Enter the message.  End it with /EX or Ctrl-Z on a line of its own.
> For Q1TEST only.
> /EX
< Message 1 saved, ID 1_Q1BBS.
< de Q1BBS>
> SB ALL@WW
< Title:
> News
< Enter the message.  End it with /EX or Ctrl-Z on a line of its own.
> For everyone.
> ^Z
< Message 2 saved, ID 2_Q1BBS.
< de Q1BBS>

# Anyone else sees the bulletin, but not the personal message, and can kill
# neither.
@session Q3TEST
< de Q1BBS>
> L
< Msg#  TS Size  To     @BBS     From      Date   Title
< 2     BN    50 ALL    WW       Q2TEST    31-Oct News
< de Q1BBS>
> R 1
< No message 1.
< de Q1BBS>
> K 1 2
< No message 1.
< Message 2 isn't yours to kill.
< de Q1BBS>

# The addressee, on any SSID, sees it; reading it marks it read, and they
# can kill it.
@session Q1TEST-5
< de Q1BBS>
> LM
< Msg#  TS Size  To     @BBS     From      Date   Title
< 1     PN    53 Q1TEST          Q2TEST    31-Oct Private
< de Q1BBS>
> R 1
< Msg #1  P  ID 1_Q1BBS
< From:  Q2TEST
< To:    Q1TEST
< Date:  31-Oct-26 12:34Z
< Title: Private
< Path:  Q1BBS
<
< For Q1TEST only.
<
< de Q1BBS>
> LM
< Msg#  TS Size  To     @BBS     From      Date   Title
< 1     PY    53 Q1TEST          Q2TEST    31-Oct Private
< de Q1BBS>
> K 1
< Message 1 killed.
< de Q1BBS>
> R 1
< No message 1.
< de Q1BBS>

# The sysop sees everything, and can kill anything.
@session Q9TEST sysop
< de Q1BBS>
> L> ALL
< Msg#  TS Size  To     @BBS     From      Date   Title
< 2     BN    50 ALL    WW       Q2TEST    31-Oct News
< de Q1BBS>
> K 2
< Message 2 killed.
< de Q1BBS>
> L
< No messages.
< de Q1BBS>
